import unittest
from unittest.mock import Mock
from your_module import Symptom, ConsultationRequest

class TestSymptoms(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_add_new_symptom(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()

        # Act
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(consultation_request.symptoms), 1)
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.symptoms[0].description, "SRS value for symptom description")

    def test_view_and_update_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Act
        updated_description = "Updated SRS value for symptom description"
        consultation_request.update_symptom_details(symptom, updated_description)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.symptoms[0].description, updated_description)

    def test_delete_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Act
        consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(symptom)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(consultation_request.symptoms), 0)

    def test_delete_non_existent_symptom_details(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")

        # Act and Assert
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            consultation_request.delete_symptom_details(symptom)

    def test_duplicate_symptom_addition(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Act
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(consultation_request.symptoms), 1)

    def test_duplicate_id_handling(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom1 = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description", id=1)
        symptom2 = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description", id=1)
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()

        # Act
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom1)
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom2)

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(consultation_request.symptoms), 1)

    def test_patient_selection_of_symptoms(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Act
        patient_selected_symptoms = consultation_request.get_patient_selected_symptoms()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(len(patient_selected_symptoms), 1)
        self.assertEqual(patient_selected_symptoms[0].description, "SRS value for symptom description")

    def test_broad_integration_with_consultation_requests(self):
        # Arrange
        symptom = Symptom(description="SRS value for symptom description")
        consultation_request = ConsultationRequest()
        consultation_request.add_symptom(symptom)

        # Act
        consultation_request.submit()

        # Assert
        self.assertEqual(consultation_request.status, "submitted")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
